notes.title: Omega Reaction to become FREE
notes.notes:
I'd like to thank everyone who has played purchased Omega Reaction.  At this point the game is over 2 years old, and besides some new cusomters when put on a Steam sale, purchases of Omega Reaction have dried up.  I'd like for more people to play this game though, so I'd like to announce my intention of changing Omega Reaction a free game.  

There will not be any tacked on in game advertisements, microtransactions, DLC, or other monetization schemes.  Just changed to free.  Please do not purchase this game after this announcement if it is still listed as costing money, instead wait until it becomes free on Steam.  There will not be any refunds issued for previous purchases.  

Thanks to everyone!
-Nick Van Fossen
Joe Censored Games LLC

notes.title: 90% off Super Sale Next Week!
notes.notes:
Omega Reaction will be having a one time 90% off super sale starting April 16th for one week!  Yes it has been on sale before, but 90% off is just ridiculous, so don't expect such a deep price cut again any time soon.  

So add it to your wish list now, and pick it up next week!

notes.title: Welcome to all the new Omega Reaction players!
notes.notes:
I'd like to welcome all the new Omega Reaction players to the game who have picked it up during this very successful 75% off super sale.  The player base has nearly doubled just in the past two weeks!  I hope all of you are able to beat level 30 to win the game!

If you haven't already, there is still a short time to pick up this unique and fast paced game for 75% off the normal price.
